values./system/biography: A luminous Stingwing mutation whose fizzing venom violently carbonates its victim’s blood.
values./items/@441804bf6a43371e/system/descript: This character cannot suffer damage or effects from radiation.
values./items/@cdc18b962c8b07bd/system/descript: This character cannot suffer damage or effects from poison.
values./items/@595986472a8bcac0/system/descript: It flies freely, ignores ground obstacles, must move each turn and suffers falling damage when knocked prone.
values./items/@4bc0388a33788c52/system/descript: It is slain by any hit that inflicts an Injury.
values./items/@e336225d5ceeb677/system/descript: After moving into Reach it may reroll 1d20 on Fizzing Stinger, then spend 1 AP to move one zone.
